title: Credit Builder Accounts: Promptness of the Early-Closure Request and the Returned-Fee Relief
content:
The relief share of the early-closure returned-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the borrower's early-closure request came soon after the most recent returned payment.

## Request timing

When the pending early-closure request was registered on the return date or 1 to 7 calendar days after it, the prompt-request addition is added; when 8 to 30 days after, the later-request addition; when later, or when the request was registered before the return date, nothing is added for promptness.

The return date is the date of the most recent returned payment's return line; the request date is the day the pending early-closure request was registered, shown on the request record. The days are the request date less the return date.

| Request registered | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| on the return date, or 1 to 7 days after | prompt-request addition: 0.15 (15 percentage points) |
| 8 to 30 days after | later-request addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| 31 days or more after, or before the return date | nothing |

## Day counts (hypothetical dates)

Return dated 10 March: a request registered 17 March (7 days) takes the prompt-request addition; 18 March (8 days) the later-request addition; 9 April (30 days) the later-request addition; 10 April (31 days) nothing; 8 March, before the return, nothing.
